result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order queries use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -o test -Dtest='*SalesRep*'` and it exited 0. I didn't check whether any test covers this method.
